title: Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome Presenting With Iron-Deficiency Anaemia and a Giant Colonic Polyp.
authors: Naher N, Al Masud A, Biswas SK, Imam H, Hasan MN.
figures: Mucocutaneous pigmentation involving the lips (a) and pulp of the fingers (b).
Colonoscopy findings shows a pedunculated polyp in the colon (Figure  2a ) and large polypoidal mass within the colon (Figure  2b ). Snare polypectomy was performed to remove the polyp (Figure  2c ).

Histological section showing Peutz-Jeghers polyp with arborizing smooth muscle fibers extending from the muscularis mucosa into the lamina propria, forming a tree-like pattern within the colonic epithelium.
Coronal magnetic resonance enterography (MRE) images show multiple polypoid lesions (marked by red arrows) within the intestine.
